assertions_reviewed: Exact durable ticket releases one vote; wrong session/ticket and second candidate are refused.
Applied histories compare entries at each index, preserve acknowledged operations over native disk recovery, repair divergent suffixes after partitions, and require current-term quorum reads.
raft.limits: Native/host fault schedules and compatible raft-rs differential traces are finite; no Byzantine or all-media-loss claim.

assertions_reviewed: Shared LogStore exercise checks forged scoped tickets, accepted-versus-durable visibility, old-generation barrier refusal, exact bounded fetch, protected committed prefix, and cross-store independence.
Native/host reopened stores retain hard state and exact histories; crash cuts fence failed publication.
storage.limits: Tests support the selected native journal and public host implementations; arbitrary third-party storage is not certified.

assertions_reviewed: Stage identity, exact reference, immutable content and two independent log anchors are checked.
Failed/unfinished publication cannot provide restore or reclamation authority; replay checks schema, dedup and suffix.
snapshots.limits: Final deep logical native Mac402 checkpoint path remains open separately; old snapshot cannot count for new frontier.

assertions_reviewed: Hundred-group histories use one shared store/scheduler and recover acknowledged state.
Held dependencies let unrelated groups run; admission reserves control credit, tests identity/byte limits, and preserves host resources after one instance closes.
runtime.limits: Mac315b exact native-only compacted100-group effect_owner history still failed in located evidence; no10-second product SLA is inferred. Performance thresholds are P9.

assertions_reviewed: All nine-voter quorum combinations intersect and optimized frontier matches reference.
Duplicate leaves/depth/overflow/weight errors fail validation; effective old/Joint/final predicates control elections, reads and commit rather than bootstrap majority.
quorum.limits: Finite validated fixed policies; arbitrary quorum predicates and utilization-based hot changes excluded.

assertions_reviewed: Old checkpoint plus genuine Final-to-Joint rollback restores actual election policy through139 native failure schedules.
Dynamic learners cannot vote/campaign/read; recovered assignments, exact readiness, configured peer routing and Joint/Final receipts gate promotion.
membership.limits: Actual physical and Joint logical paths qualified as recorded; latest repeated398 Mac result was reported by root, not independently inspected here.

assertions_reviewed: Host policy resolves exact disjoint scopes; cycles/gaps/overlaps and stale generations are rejected.
Downstream discovery fetches only needed path, leaves unrelated child absent, and a warm child remains usable after parent source closes.
Native nested merge retirement restarts with only one old owner retired, rejects old fenced owner, preserves original retries on target and finally reopens retired stores.
routing.limits: Per-owner ordering only; evidence does not promise global total order across partitioned lanes.

assertions_reviewed: Supplied NetworkNode construction refusal returns original provider; own poll/drain/reclaim occurs without granting catalogue authority.
Local send completion is separated from remote durability, bounded buffers and exact original peer/context guard ingress; revoked/closed secure sessions cannot silently succeed.
transport.limits: Only implemented TLS/QUIC and selected host contracts; no unsupported arbitrary transport/codec Cartesian combinations.

assertions_reviewed: Shared host/native timer obligations check exact owner/token/generation cancellation, bounded poll ordering and refusal; five defective providers are detected.
Caller monotonic time drives deterministic events and election jitter.
timer.limits: Timer waking does not establish quorum authority; unbounded generations and arbitrary provider implementation are not proved.

assertions_reviewed: DiagnosticClock is separate from monotonic Clock; signed epoch/subsecond conversion is native SystemTime-only.
Injected wall jumps i128 extremes leave exact election deadline and monotonic value unchanged; explicit diagnostic read count does not increase inside consensus timing.
clock.limits: Linux54/54/37/54 +2 pass; Mac401 remains pending. Earlier384 catalogue omission is corrected, not silently treated optional.

assertions_reviewed: Generated host/native buffer histories retain per-owner/per-class byte credits across transfers and cross-thread final releases; bad early-release provider is detected.
buffers.limits: Bounded test pools and selected native/host implementations, not allocator throughput measurements.

assertions_reviewed: Shared native/host application checker enforces original replies, no partial apply on refusal, barrier reads, checkpoint restoration and dedup.
Client queues distinguish admitted/written/committed/applied and retain Unknown until original recovery.
application.limits: Application schema-specific atomicity; no SQL or unspecified transaction semantics.

assertions_reviewed: Assignment intent binds exact group/store/configuration and is refused before persistence if invalid/overbudget.
Learners do not supply quorum/domain survival; weighted/recursive policy remains authority, not placement score.
policy.limits: Placement is proposal-only; automatic cluster orchestration is not a promised initial service.

assertions_reviewed: Wrong owner/session/generation and regressing diagnostics are refused; fixed counters saturate and exported values have independent lifetime.
Closing one observer leaves another owner alive; diagnostics refusal cannot change write/read/shutdown.
observability.limits: No claim of P9 measurement completeness or production telemetry integration beyond public bounded adapters.

assertions_reviewed: Host validity prevents provider I/O when invalid and suppresses success if invalidated during I/O; returning raw session first revokes it.
Native rotation closes old channels, returns exact accepted work as failed, and new pins preserve stable peer identity.
credentials.limits: Existing authentication/failure contracts only; dedicated security review/hardening is P10.

assertions_reviewed: Bounded codecs reject truncation, every single-bit log-frame mutation, unknown mandatory formats and contradictory lengths.
Snapshot and native log codecs preserve distinct persistent contracts; optional compression is absent rather than advertised.
formats.limits: 16896 selected deterministic corpus cases are not exhaustive fuzzing or security certification.

assertions_reviewed: Independent prefix/suffix/snapshot graphs require no frontier and replay four intentionally weakened failures.
Actual native file tests cut30 publication and reclaim/parity transitions, reopen original stores, require exact acknowledged prefix and safe next generation.
Actual striped Node histories use one ordinary ordered Raft log with separate local device payload lanes.
striped.limits: Fixed selected layouts and surviving-device assumptions; not globally ordered distributed lanes or all-device-loss recovery.

assertions_reviewed: Seven finite graphs preserve original source identity and durable evidence across relays; weakenings reveal invented/duplicate/written-only/stale acknowledgments.
Two-helper actual TCP/QUIC trees cover minority loss, late replies, helper restart and same-WAL/checkpoint replay; helpers never become voter evidence.
relays.limits: Static checked topology max16 hops; automatic dialing/arbitrary topology proof not advertised; benchmarks are P9.

assertions_reviewed: Independent nine logical graphs preserve promises, payload dependencies and serialized replicated activation intents; original weakening counterexamples replay.
Full native deep test writes5, records checkpoint plus suffix, joins27 original owners, recovers same stores and newer sessions, requires exact duplicate replies/read5 and final27 joins.
Joint tests reopen12 stores at actual committed Joint; repeated replacement preserves genuine Learners/Joint/Final/Outcome/Release.
logical.limits: Mac deep full recovery currently failed398 and pending402; Linux9/7 pass402. Representative refinement uses qualified ordinary child consensus; finite models are not an unbounded proof.

assertions_reviewed: Finite three-participant two-key model checks atomicity/isolation and four original weakening violations.
Actual five-group programs preserve prepare locks across checkpoint/suffix cold recovery, recorded decisions, contention abort and coordinator-leader replacement; retries retain original outcomes.
transactions.limits: Fixed-key numeric versioned programs are supported; SQL, moving keys and atomic global scans are not implied by broader transactions.
